answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using verifiable delay functions. Nodes must solve sequential cryptographic puzzles to broadcast an authenticated heartbeat signal across a gossip vine network. This forces attackers to expend scarce, non-parallelizable processor time per identity instead of spawning free software clones. Validators in a lotus topology verify these outputs. However, adversaries using specialized ASIC hardware gain an unfair speed advantage over standard agents.
